note: staleAfterDays is a stall threshold (days a prospect can sit in that stage before the board flags it), based on general sales-pipeline norms (mid-stage deals with no activity for 20+ days are commonly treated as stalled). It only fires when stageEnteredDate is actually logged on a prospect, never guessed.

stages.label: Researched
stages.description: Identified as a real fit. No outreach sent yet.

stages.label: Outreach Sent
stages.description: First message sent. Waiting on a reply.

stages.label: Silent / Replied
stages.description: Either no response after the nudge window, or a reply came in that has not moved to active exploration.

stages.label: In Exploration
stages.description: Active back and forth about a real partnership or deal.
